noneYet: You are not in any group yet.

policyText.open: Anyone can join and take part in decisions.
policyText.request: Members decide about new members, because members vote on goals.

visText.public: Everyone can read the chat, goals and history.
visText.members: Only members see content. The group does not appear in search.

whyJoin: Why do you want to join? (optional)
joinToPost: Join the group to write here.
needsIntro: Contact only happens when both sides agree.
rightsText: Organisers can adjust the rights of stewards, members and guests. Organisers can always do everything.

goals.none: No goals yet. Propose the first one!
goals.needs: What is missing? Posted as wanted.
goals.needsPlaceholder: e.g. projector, 300 €, someone who can edit video
goals.rule: The group votes for 7 days. The goal is adopted with a majority of voting members, if at least half of the members vote.

form.title: Start a group
form.lead: You decide what the group is for.
form.leadShort: What is the group for? You decide.
form.name: Name
form.inviteNote: {name} will be invited as soon as the group exists.

presets.title: Who is the group for?
presets.text: A preset sets everything up to fit. You can change every setting afterwards.

sports.name: Sports club
sports.text: Publicly visible, joining on request. Departments as subgroups, training times as courses.

school.name: School class or school
school.text: Secret, invitation only. Letters to parents as documents, trips and duties as tasks.

daycare.name: Day-care parents
daycare.text: Secret, adults only, by invitation. Car pools and pick-up duties as tasks.

neighbours.name: Neighbourhood or building
neighbours.text: Visible to members, joining on request. Lending and helping through Matters.

faith.name: Faith community
faith.text: Public, joining on request. Volunteer duties as tasks, choir or youth as subgroups.

firebrigade.name: Volunteer fire brigade or relief group
firebrigade.text: For members, invitation only. Duty rosters and drills as tasks, papers as documents.

foodsharing.name: Food sharing or food bank
foodsharing.text: Open to everyone. Pick-ups as tasks, food as offers in the marketplace.

repair.name: Repair café or open workshop
repair.text: Open to everyone. Dates as courses, tools to lend as offers.

citizens.name: Citizens' initiative
citizens.text: Public and open. Demands as initiatives with a vote, research as documents.

housing.name: Housing project or cooperative
housing.text: For members, adults only, by invitation. Decisions as goals, cleaning and garden duties as tasks.

chat.name: Chat group
chat.text: A few people, just chat. Add tools when needed.

couple.name: Just the two of us
couple.text: Couple, family, friends: plan with tasks, documents and shared expenses.

flatshare.name: Flat share
flatshare.text: For the flatmates, by invitation only. Cleaning as tasks, groceries and rent as shared expenses.

tools.title: Tools
tools.text: The group has only what it needs. Switching a tool off hides it, nothing is deleted.
tools.formText: Without tools the group is simply a chat. You can change this any time.
tools.always: Always there: chat, members with roles and rights, about the group.

needs.name: Listings
needs.text: What the group is looking for

expenses.name: Split expenses
expenses.text: Who paid what, who owes whom, with receipts

calendar.name: Calendar and duties
calendar.text: Dates with yes and no, duty rotas in turn

nextcloud.name: Nextcloud
nextcloud.text: Show photos from a folder and the calendar of your Nextcloud
